summary: Join Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS) Training to master innovative techniques in sustainable aquaculture. Elevate your expertise and boost your career.
lede: RAS fish farming training helps operators, production managers, engineers, and water-quality specialists connect fish production needs with treatment-system performance. Participants practice calculating ammonia loads, assessing biofilter capacity, balancing oxygen demand, checking water circulation, and interpreting fish-behaviour indicators, then apply these skills to monitoring plans, alarm responses, maintenance schedules, and system performance dashboards.
audienceIntro: This intermediate RAS training is designed for professionals who operate, supervise, design, monitor, or support recirculating aquaculture facilities and need to connect biological requirements with treatment-system performance.
modules: RAS Mass Balance and Water Quality
prerequisites: You should have practical exposure to aquaculture production, water-quality monitoring, aquatic animal husbandry, or process engineering. Basic confidence with ratios, unit conversions, and spreadsheet calculations is expected. Coding or programming is not required. Bring a laptop capable of running Microsoft Excel and viewing Power BI files; the course uses provided datasets and templates. Advanced ozone design, AI anomaly detection, and control architecture are taught at conceptual awareness or operational application depth, while RAS calculations, diagnostics, dashboards, and action plans receive hands-on practice.
